condo: Nanhua Pri School, within 1km ! Let me help you to find the most suitable unit for your family !

history.summary: A 2023 99-yr leasehold 4BR in Clementi/West Coast (D05), 1,206 sqft at $2.5M / $2,073 psf, marketed on Nanhua Primary 1km proximity but a long 1.17km/14-min walk to Clementi MRT. The listing title obscures the actual project name, the school angle is an own-stay (not investment) draw, and at $2,073 psf for a $2.5M 4BR with no project URA data it's a fair-value, school-driven hold.
history.rating_rationale: $2,073 psf for a 2023 99-yr LH 4BR is full pricing, and $2.5M sits above the deep-liquidity band for a niche 4BR. The headline pitch is Nanhua Primary balloting — an own-stay/family driver, not investment value. 1.17km to Clementi MRT is a weak walk. No project-specific URA series (regional-baseline). The spam-style title also obscures the real development, lowering data confidence. D05 One-North/TEL and CRL Clementi interchange are the regional offsets.
red_flags: Obscured project name in listing title — reduced data confidence
1.17km / 14-min walk to Clementi MRT — weak connectivity
School-proximity pitch is an own-stay driver, not an investment catalyst
No project-specific URA appreciation data — regional-baseline fallback
catalysts: 1km to Nanhua Primary — sustained family/own-stay demand
D05 One-North tech hub + Cross Island Line Clementi interchange (~2030)
Near-new 2023 build at sub-$2.5M for a 4BR
